<!--

    @see: https://gitlab.Fede RL03.com/Fede RL03/development/docs/-/blob/master/contributing/code/patches.md#make-a-pull-request.

    | Q             | A
    | ------------- | ---
    | Branch        | master      ("master" for features, improvements and deprecations / lowest applicable and maintained version otherwise)
    | Bug fix?      | yes/no      (target branch MUST be an stable branch)
    | New feature?  | yes/no      (target branch MUST be "master")
    | BC breaks?    | yes/no      (BC breaks SHOULD only be introduced in MAJOR releases)
    | Deprecations? | yes/no      (target branch MUST be "master")
    | Fixed tickets | [Mastery-*]    (the issue reference)
    | License       | proprietary (for legal reasons, the only accepted license type is "proprietary")

-->
| Q             | A
| ------------- | ---
| Branch        | master
| Bug fix?      | no
| New feature?  | yes
| BC breaks?    | no
| Deprecations? | no
| Fixed tickets | [Mastery-*]
| License       | proprietary
<!--

    If the title is not enough to explain what motivates this pull request, you MUST add a more detailed description here.

-->

    If a pull request is a draft, you MUST specify in a TODO list what it needs to be ready for merging.
